definitions.global_key_projection: Rule i writes a resource read by rule j; attributes are matched solely by key, a high-recall overapproximation.
definitions.nodes: Active authored rules in each seed manifest.
definitions.partition: Recursive balanced bisection of seed rule order, or a fixed-seed permutation, until each leaf frame has at most four rules.
definitions.treewidth: Undirected simple projection of the directed rule dependency graph; exact when rule count<=10, min-fill upper bound otherwise.
definitions.variable_role_projection: Attribute resources are refined by the matched edge-role signature of the referenced variable; this is sensitivity analysis and may miss dependencies when runtime nodes alias across distinct roles.
definitions.wildcards: Node deletion, value replacement, and unknown effect forms conservatively connect to every rule read set.

limits: Seed-level rule specifications, not dynamic runtime graph snapshots.
Native access-set comparison is source-extractor versus loaded RewriteRule::derive_access readback only; it does not capture data-dependent runtime access traces.
Dependency edges are static conservative projections; runtime aliasing, guards, scheduler state, and effect semantics can make them incomplete or overconnected.
No partitioned execution, update cost, or monolithic semantic parity is measured.
protocol: seed-derived rule-dependency census v2; benchmark protocol 1.1
